newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil firmer on arbitrage bids.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil firmer on arbitrage bids.

text.p: European straight-run fuel oil prices were mostly firmer in line with cracked prices and arbitrage interest, despite the competitive crude values, dealers said.
Low sulphur North Sea cargoes were in thin demand due to Wednesday's sharp drop in crude, but Russian high sulphur straight-run from the Baltic was being actively sold across the Atlantic.
A 50,000 tonne cargo loading on Dec 3 in Talin was fixed to sail to the U.S. Gulf by Coastal, ship brokers said.
